boiled_potato31: They issued Edmund Potato a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a cracked shaving mirror in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
A child had enclosed a riddle in a parcel for Edmund Potato. The answer was on the back. He kept the dugout guessing until supper.

Edmund Potato of the Hegemony and Bram Archiegregor of the Concord watched a broken branch near Calvary Farm all morning. Neither side could afford to assume it was only a branch. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Edmund Potato read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
bw911k: Norbert Bwk unpacked a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts at S-F18. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Norbert Bwk let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
d4rth_bao: Day 3. The corporal put Gideon Bao beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F7, Gideon Bao listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
